t: A lesson where students build an interactive storyboard with a Makey Makey.
steps: Find the Makey Makey Storyboards lesson on the ASU STEM Teachers site.
Buy Makey Makey kits for the class.
Set up a computer for each group.
Gather paper, foil and other conductive items.
Choose a story or a content topic.
Test a touch point before class.
Check what the lesson says about software and accounts.
